sloka: अवध्यत्वं मया प्राप्तं देवगन्धर्वदानवैः ।राक्षसैर्गुह्यकैर्नागैर्ये चान्ये बलवत्तराः ।। ७.१६.४२ ॥
transliteration: avadhyatvaṁ mayā prāptaṁ devagandharvadānavaiḥ ।rākṣasairguhyakairnāgairye cānye balavattarāḥ ।। 7.16.42 ॥

translations.english: I have already obtained the boon of invincibility against gods, gandharvas, danavas, rakshasas, guhyakas, nagas, and any other more powerful beings.
